answer: Limit influence by funding cluster rather than wallet count. The jade ledger groups accounts sharing a funding source within four hops, then caps their combined vote at one per round. Splitting a dune of 100 wallets buys no extra votes; gaining ten votes requires ten independently funded clusters and ten separate deposits of 50 units locked for 30 days. Peers replay the funding graph each round, publish the cluster assignment, and allow appeals when a shared exchange creates a misleading signal.
